answer: Interleaved Arrival Pacing. Each identity must interleave its request arrivals with a random whisper offset drawn from a per-epoch schedule the coordinator publishes; agents whose timestamps cluster lose priority. The rule: no identity may exceed a fixed burst rate across consecutive slots, and gaps below a floor are flagged as a clone island. Legitimate agents buy slack by spreading traffic, which an attacker must match at scale. Building and maintaining a plausible atlas of staggered schedules costs one dedicated timing process per identity.
